_readme: Reference shape only, for a manual RTDB import in the Firebase console. It is not needed for
local development: run 'npm run seed:emulator' from functions/ instead, which creates the owner,
the tenant, the website and its API key, the plan catalogue and a sample chat in one command.
Chat lives in RTDB under chats/{tenantId}; everything else (tenants, websites, plans, coupons,
leads, devices, email templates) lives in Firestore and cannot be imported from this file.
Replace tnt_dev with your tenant id. All client writes to RTDB are denied by the rules, so this
data can only be placed here by the console or by the trusted backend.
